test_scenario: Home page loads for a logged-out visitor
expected_result: Page loads (HTTP 200). Navbar shows 'BenchShare Portal' and 'Please login or register' with NO Logout button. Login box and Register box with role dropdown (Student, Lab Assistant, Administrator) are visible.
actual_result: HTTP 200 OK. Navbar rendered with portal branding and 'Please login or register'. Login form and Register form with role selector rendered with Tailwind CSS.

expected_result: Redirected to home (/); flash message 'Registration successful! Please login.' is displayed; user is not auto-logged in.
actual_result: Redirected to /; flash message 'Registration successful! Please login.' displayed; user account created in database.

expected_result: Flash message 'Registration successful! Please login.' and account created with role 'Lab Assistant'.
actual_result: Redirected to / with flash message 'Registration successful! Please login.'; Lab Assistant account registered.

test_scenario: Register a valid Administrator (needed to run Admin tests)
expected_result: Flash message 'Registration successful! Please login.' and account created with role 'Administrator'.
actual_result: Redirected to / with flash message 'Registration successful! Please login.'; Administrator account registered.

expected_result: Registration rejected with flash message 'Registration failed. Email or Reg No might already exist.'
actual_result: Registration blocked. Flash message 'Registration failed. Email or Reg No might already exist.' displayed.

expected_result: Registration rejected with flash message 'Registration failed. Email or Reg No might already exist.'
actual_result: Registration blocked. Flash message 'Registration failed. Email or Reg No might already exist.' displayed.

test_scenario: Registration POST with missing fields (no browser validation)
expected_result: Server-side rejection with 400 Bad Request or validation error message blocking blank registration.
actual_result: FAILED: Server accepted empty strings, redirected HTTP 302/200, displayed 'Registration successful! Please login.' and created a ghost user record with blank credentials.

test_scenario: Login as Student with valid credentials
expected_result: Logged in successfully; welcome header displays 'Welcome, Test Student a318e7 (Student)'; equipment directory and reserve buttons visible; Logout link visible.
actual_result: Logged in successfully. Session cookie established. Navbar displays 'Welcome, Test Student a318e7 (Student)' and Logout button.

expected_result: Logged in successfully; welcome header displays 'Welcome, Test Assistant a318e7 (Lab Assistant)'; Reservations queue shows Approve and Reject action buttons.
actual_result: Logged in successfully. Navbar displays 'Welcome, Test Assistant a318e7 (Lab Assistant)'. Reservations queue shows Approve and Reject buttons for Pending items.

expected_result: Logged in successfully; welcome header displays 'Welcome, Test Admin a318e7 (Administrator)'; 'Add New Laboratory Equipment (Admin Only)' form visible.
actual_result: Logged in successfully. Navbar displays 'Welcome, Test Admin a318e7 (Administrator)'. Add New Laboratory Equipment form rendered prominently.

expected_result: Login rejected with flash message 'Invalid credentials!'; user remains logged out.
actual_result: Login rejected. Flash message 'Invalid credentials!' displayed. No session established.

expected_result: Login rejected with flash message 'Invalid credentials!'; user remains logged out.
actual_result: Login rejected. Flash message 'Invalid credentials!' displayed. No session established.

expected_result: Session cleared, redirected to home page, flash message 'Logged out successfully.' displayed, login/register forms visible again.
actual_result: Session destroyed. Redirected to / with flash message 'Logged out successfully.' Public landing page displayed.

expected_result: Equipment added, flash message 'New equipment added successfully!', equipment card visible with status 'Available'.
actual_result: Flash message 'New equipment added successfully!' displayed. Equipment 'Spectrum Analyzer Pro' visible in directory with status 'Available'.

expected_result: Action rejected with flash message 'Unauthorized access!'; no equipment added to database.
actual_result: Blocked. Flash message 'Unauthorized access!' displayed. Equipment not added.

test_scenario: Lab Assistant cannot add equipment (direct POST)
expected_result: Action rejected with flash message 'Unauthorized access!'; no equipment added.
actual_result: Blocked. Flash message 'Unauthorized access!' displayed. Equipment not added.

test_scenario: Logged-out user cannot add equipment (direct POST)
expected_result: Action rejected with flash message 'Unauthorized access!'; no equipment added.
actual_result: Blocked. Flash message 'Unauthorized access!' displayed. Guest blocked.

test_scenario: Student reserves an Available item (reservation R-A)
expected_result: Reservation created with status 'Pending', equipment status updated to 'Reserved', flash message 'Reservation request submitted successfully!'.
actual_result: Reservation created with status 'Pending'. Equipment updated to 'Reserved'. Flash message 'Reservation request submitted successfully!' displayed.

test_scenario: Queue row shows correct reservation details

test_inputs.description: Attempt to reserve already reserved equipment

expected_result: Reservation blocked with flash message 'Yeh equipment pehle se reserved hai!'.
actual_result: Blocked cleanly. Flash message 'Yeh equipment pehle se reserved hai!' displayed.

test_scenario: Same student, same time slot, different item (exact text)
expected_result: Second reservation blocked with flash message 'Aapne is time slot par pehle hi ek equipment reserve kiya hua hai!'.
actual_result: Second booking blocked. Flash message 'Aapne is time slot par pehle hi ek equipment reserve kiya hua hai!' displayed.

expected_result: Unauthenticated request denied; redirected to home page without creating reservation.
actual_result: Redirected to /; no reservation created in database.

test_scenario: Lab Assistant approves a Pending reservation (R-A)
expected_result: Reservation status changes to 'Approved', equipment stays 'Reserved', flash message 'Reservation #3 Approved.'.
actual_result: Reservation status updated to 'Approved' in queue table. Flash message 'Reservation #3 Approved.' displayed.

expected_result: Administrator can approve pending reservation; status updated to 'Approved'.
actual_result: Administrator has full approval permissions; reservation status successfully updated.

test_scenario: Lab Assistant rejects a Pending reservation (R-B)
expected_result: Reservation status changes to 'Rejected', equipment status resets to 'Available', flash message 'Reservation #4 Rejected.'.
actual_result: Reservation status updated to 'Rejected'. Associated equipment status reset to 'Available'. Flash message 'Reservation #4 Rejected.' displayed.

expected_result: Access denied; student redirected to home page without changing reservation status.
actual_result: Blocked. Redirected to / without approving reservation.

expected_result: Access denied; student redirected to home page without changing reservation status.
actual_result: Blocked. Redirected to / without rejecting reservation.

expected_result: Unauthenticated access denied; redirected without modifying reservation status.
actual_result: Blocked. Unauthenticated guest redirected to / without modifying status.

expected_result: Session cookie contains HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite (Lax or Strict) flags over HTTPS.
actual_result: FAILED: Set-Cookie header contains HttpOnly, but lacks 'Secure' and 'SameSite' attributes on live HTTPS deployment. (Raw: 'session=...; HttpOnly; Path=/')

test_scenario: Passwords are not stored in plain text

test_inputs.database_inspection: User table schema and stored records

expected_result: Passwords are cryptographically hashed using PBKDF2 / Bcrypt / Argon2 before database storage.
actual_result: FAILED: Passwords stored and compared as raw cleartext strings in User table (db.Column(db.String(100))). Zero hashing implemented.

test_scenario: State-changing actions must not work via a plain link (GET)
expected_result: All state-changing actions require a unique, cryptographically validated CSRF token.
actual_result: FAILED: Zero CSRF tokens in templates or Flask backend. State-changing GET links (/approve, /reject, /logout) and POST forms are fully vulnerable to CSRF.
